2608.11727.title: Harness-IF: Evaluating Instruction Following Across Instruction Surfaces in Coding Agents
2608.11727.paper_summary: When a coding agent obeys a rule, it may simply have been going to do that anyway. Existing instruction-following benchmarks cannot tell the difference: they concentrate rules in the user turn, while coding-agent benchmarks emphasize final task success. We introduce Harness-IF, which scores operational rules one at a time from execution evidence: 60 realistic multi-turn coding items drawn from a 642-rule library, 256 rules receiving verdicts, placed on the five configurable surfaces a deployed agent reads. To separate compliance from coincidence we introduce Against-Prior Accuracy (AP-Acc), which scores only rules labeled as opposing unprompted defaults, observed by re-running tasks with the rule withheld across nine probe builds and curated otherwise. Across 12 frontier models, accuracy spans 72.1-85.9% and AP-Acc 66.1-78.6%; every model is worse on against-prior rules, by 3.6 to 7.4 points (mean 5.81), and the direction survives a common-support analysis with item-clustered intervals. Aggregate scores therefore overstate compliance by a model-specific margin: prior control leaves the top build unchanged and exchanges three adjacent rank pairs. A counterbalanced conflict pilot on nine separate builds adds a second result: pooled precedence does not follow prompt depth, with system prompts, project files, and user instructions ahead of tool and skill descriptions.
2608.11727.paper_summary_zh: 當一個編碼代理遵循一條規則時，它可能本來就會這樣做。現有的指令遵循基準無法區分這一點：它們將規則集中在用戶的回合，而編碼代理基準則強調最終任務的成功。我們引入了 Harness-IF，這是一個根據執行證據逐一評分操作規則的系統：60 個來自 642 條規則庫的現實多回合編碼項目，256 條規則獲得評價，放置在已部署代理所讀取的五個可配置表面上。為了將遵從與巧合分開，我們引入了 Against-Prior Accuracy (AP-Acc)，該指標僅評分標記為反對未提示默認的規則，這是通過在九個探查構建中重新運行任務並在其他方面進行策劃來觀察的。在 12 個前沿模型中，準確率範圍為 72.1-85.9%，AP-Acc 為 66.1-78.6%；每個模型在反對先前規則的表現上都較差，下降幅度為 3.6 到 7.4 分（平均 5.81），且這一趨勢在使用項目聚類區間的共同支持分析中得以保留。因此，總體得分在模型特定的範圍內誇大了遵從度：先前的控制使得最佳構建保持不變，並交換了三對相鄰的排名。對九個不同構建進行的平衡衝突試點提供了第二個結果：聚合優先權並不隨提示深度而變化，系統提示、項目文件和用戶指令在工具和技能描述之前。
